customer_api_invalid_token.notes: Authorization header present but not a parseable Bearer value (HTTP 401).

customer_api_token_no_stores.notes: Customer token row exists but StoreIds is empty/missing (HTTP 409).

customer_api_forbidden_store.notes: Device exists but its Group is not in the caller token's StoreIds (HTTP 403).

customer_api_invalid_query_param.notes: Caller-supplied query string parameter (limit / cursor on /jobs) is missing-shape, out-of-range, or unparseable (HTTP 400).
